attack_techniques: Credentials from Password Stores: Cloud Secrets Management Stores (T1555.006)
attackers_goals: Abuse exposed secrets to gain access to restricted cloud resources and applications.
description: A cloud Identity performed a secret management operation for the first time.
investigative_actions: Check the identity's role designation in the organization. Verify that the identity did not perform any sensitive secret management operation that it shouldn't.
name: Unusual secret management activity
